safe_preview.scope: Qualify exactly-one Action Run condition to leaf Steps that run an Action; preserve Summary, metadata and other Claim/Details. R2465 permits a leaf Step to run a Workflow instead.
safe_preview.workflow_leaf: The qualification does not require an Action or Action Run for a Step whose selected executable is a Workflow; it does not define a new Workflow-run execution rule.

finding: R1528 requires an Action Run for each Action-running leaf and describes containing Step Runs and nested Step Runs; E486 says each executed nested Substep receives its own Step Run. Proposed R2751/R2245 bind Step Run only to Step, whereas Current R2466 declares Substep as a distinct kind. Settled no Substep Run does not itself choose whether Step Run may execute a Substep. No source identified which names the Run-parent relation or supplies required outgoing direct and derived allowances, so merely adding IS_CONTAINED_BY or a whitelist would assume an unapproved binding.
question: When a Substep executes, should its execution use a Step Run that can bind to a Substep, or should its Action Run be recorded without a separate per-Substep Step Run?
gates: Resolve nested-run representation before changing R2751/R2245 or E486, and specify the actual Run-parent relation and both outgoing permissions independently before writing formal cardinalities.

If choosing Action-only leaf qualification, review R1528 preview against E486/E495 and update dependent source authority consistently; this preview does not authorize changing actual Workflow instances.
Integrate the approved :: notation only in a reviewed common source/syntax pass; do not change existing bounds.
No Current, actual Draft, Workflow, Workbench, code, runtime, Git or Journal mutation.

decision_context.settled: A distinct Substep Run kind is not admitted. Step can contain Substeps or run an Action/Workflow; a Substep runs an Action.
decision_context.not_settled: Whether an existing Step Run can identify a Substep versus no separate per-Substep Step Run; which modeled Relation represents parentage and its direction/count.
decision_context.impact_if_step_run_binds_substep: Requires reviewing the typed Step Run definition and R2245/R2417 endpoint signatures, parentage and permissions, plus preserving E486/R1528 execution evidence. It does not create a Substep Run kind.
decision_context.impact_if_no_per_substep_step_run: Requires reviewed disposition of E486 and other claims requiring distinct Step Runs for executed nested Substeps and of R1528/R1525 parentage wording; Action Run association must use separately admitted authority.
decision_context.review_scope: These are source design consequences only; no actual Workflow instance or runtime inspection was performed.
